evidence_basis: live-offer evidence recorded in durable 3PM package

complete: 72-hour deliverable, buyer, positioning, price, onboarding, boundaries and CTA packaged
Scarcity claim fail-closed until live customer count is verified
partial: Live offer is public but full buyer conversion path has not been evidenced end-to-end in durable state
blocked: No direct evidence in durable state of a qualified buyer completing inquiry-to-payment-to-questionnaire-to-delivery
No verified customer count supporting remaining first-five scarcity
planned: Verify the complete buyer path with current evidence before claiming release-ready conversion flow

carry_forward: Remove or dynamically verify first-five scarcity before using it in outreach
Execute one compliant qualified-buyer sales action at the next scheduled weekday outreach window
pause: Large custom automation pitches before the $99 diagnostic path is verified
tomorrow_first_action: Run a current evidence-backed buyer-path verification for the $99 Automation Audit and fix the smallest failing handoff before doing new product work.
truth_rule: Scores measure today's evidenced operating state, not customer outcomes or revenue.
